source.description: Reviewed handmade raster graphite and colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One whole pomegranate behind one cut half; no labels, arrows, UI, signatures, watermarks, extra fruit, hands, plate, or decorative border.

process_strategy: Eight cumulative panels reserve the whole fruit and foreground cut half from the first frame, establish rind and seed geometry before texture, map every restrained color before the finish, and limit the final panel to reinforcement.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one upright fruit envelope, one overlapping half-circle, two crown axes, six open membrane routes, and one broken shadow footprint.

anchor_map.early_mark: One upright rounded fruit envelope with a five-point crown axis
anchor_map.becomes: The whole pomegranate behind the cut half
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The whole fruit remains left of center and is covered only at its lower-right edge by the foreground half.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open envelope and crown ticks only in Panel 1; no finished peel contour.

anchor_map.early_mark: One overlapping foreground circle with a smaller inner rind circle
anchor_map.becomes: The cut pomegranate half and pale rind ring
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The half stays lower-right, overlaps the whole fruit, and keeps the same cut face angle and scale.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale circles only in Panel 1; the complete rind contour begins in Panel 2.

anchor_map.early_mark: Six open radial membrane routes and twelve seed placement ticks
anchor_map.becomes: Six pale membrane wedges holding exactly twelve ruby seeds
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: All routes radiate from one fixed cut-face center and every pair of seeds stays inside its assigned wedge.
anchor_map.construction_note: Open routes and ticks only until the membranes and seed ovals are established in later panels.

final_elements.name: whole-fruit cut-half crown membrane and shadow guides
final_elements.description: One whole-fruit envelope, one overlapping cut-half circle, two crown axes, six membrane routes, twelve seed ticks, and one broken shadow footprint.

final_elements.name: whole pomegranate and cut-half silhouettes
final_elements.description: One upright whole fruit behind one round cut half with a thick visible rind ring.

final_elements.name: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges
final_elements.description: A five-point crown on each fruit and six pale dividing membranes inside the cut face.

final_elements.name: twelve ruby seed ovals
final_elements.description: Exactly twelve plump seed ovals arranged as two seeds inside each of the six membrane wedges.

final_elements.name: peel texture highlights and broken shadow
final_elements.description: Sparse curved peel hatching, two open-paper peel highlights, tiny seed glints, and one broken graphite shadow.

final_elements.name: graphite value and restrained pomegranate color map
final_elements.description: Directional graphite plus muted crimson peel, ruby seeds, warm cream membranes, and cool-gray shadow.

final_elements.name: seed depth and rind-edge accents
final_elements.description: Small established seed shadows, rind-edge hatching, crown creases, and clarified paper highlights.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The whole-fruit peel contour, hatching, and shadow stop at the reserved cut-half silhouette; no finished line runs through the foreground fruit.

frames.visible_job: Place one upright whole-fruit envelope, one overlapping cut-half circle, two crown axes, six open membrane routes, twelve seed ticks, and one broken shadow footprint.

establishes: whole-fruit cut-half crown membrane and shadow guides

frames.visible_job: Wrap the guides with one upright whole pomegranate and one round foreground cut half with a thick visible rind ring.
requires_prior_elements: whole-fruit cut-half crown membrane and shadow guides

frames.visible_job: Turn both crown axes into five-point crowns and divide the cut face into exactly six pale membrane wedges around the same center.
introduces: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges
establishes: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges

frames.visible_job: Turn the twelve placement ticks into exactly twelve plump seed ovals, with two seeds inside each established membrane wedge.
requires_prior_elements: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges

frames.visible_job: Add sparse curved peel hatching, two peel-highlight reserves, tiny seed glints, crown creases, and the established broken shadow.
introduces: peel texture highlights and broken shadow
establishes: peel texture highlights and broken shadow
requires_prior_elements: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges

frames.visible_job: Map graphite value, muted crimson peel, ruby seeds, warm cream membranes, and cool-gray shadow over only the established forms.

requires_prior_elements: two five-point crowns and six membrane wedges

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen the mapped graphite and color, and clarify the same seeds, membranes, highlights, crowns, and broken shadow.
allowed_changes: small established texture and highlight clarification

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel, a drifting overlap, or a cut half that changes scale or angle.
Reject any sequence that changes the two five-point crowns, six membrane wedges, or exactly twelve seeds after those elements appear.
Reject a final that introduces seeds, membranes, fruit contours, crowns, texture regions, color regions, leaves, a plate, or another prop absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, glossy poster rendering, repeated darkened tracings, labels, arrows, text, signatures, or watermarks.
